u0: The task is not yet complete: the exit has not been successfully reached, and no earlier siren alarm is still waiting for a switch response. Reaching the exit with the siren silent completes the task, and so does reaching it on a step where the switch is toggled to answer a ringing siren. The agent must operate the wall switch to silence it; doing so before reaching the exit resolves the alarm and returns progress to the ordinary unfinished condition. Reaching the exit on the same step as a switch toggle would satisfy both the alarm response and the exit goal.
u2: The task requirements have been satisfied: the agent has reached the exit, and every siren ring has been answered by a switch toggle. No further action is needed; this is the successful completion condition.
u3: The agent has reached the exit while a siren alarm remains unanswered by a switch toggle, so the run is not yet complete. The only way forward is to toggle the switch; doing so satisfies the outstanding alarm and completes the task. Until that toggle, remaining at the exit leaves completion pending, and there is no route back to ordinary progress.
